subject: Materials Science
title: Blow Molding: Making Hollow Parts
description: One-minute skill: Blow Molding: Making Hollow Parts.

hook.text: A soft blob of hot plastic drops into a mold. Air blasts in and it inflates like a balloon.

buildup.text: Blow molding creates hollow shapes — bottles, containers, fuel tanks, and drums.

discovery.text: The air pressure pushes the plastic against the mold walls, forming the exact shape.

twist.text: Car fuel tanks are blow-molded in one piece — no seams, no leak points.

climax.text: Global production of blow-molded bottles exceeds 500 billion units per year.

punchline.text: Inflate hot plastic and you bottle the world.

quiz.question: How does blow molding form a hollow shape?
options: By cutting material away from a solid block
By inflating hot plastic against mold walls with air
By spinning the mold at high speed
